why: byRank is static with no level gate (2nd at 6th, 3rd at 8th, 4th at 10th) and there is no red-mantis entry to target — with no entryId the bonus would land on the character's OWN class caster, over-granting. Needs a Red Mantis CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry plus level-gated slot unlocks.

The spell depends on the picked arcane school, so no data field on the feat can name it; needs 'advanced-school-spell': subOption?.advancedFocusSpell added to the ADV_SPELL map in build.ts (~line 1462). An effectChoices menu of all schools would let a wizard pick a school they don't have, i.e. over-grant.

cathartic-mage-dedication has no CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry, so there is no archetype spellcasting entry for any slot lane to target; needs the archetype table row (tradition choice, key ability, repertoire), which is code.

'Two slots at HALF your highest rank' is relative to the caster's level; byRank is a literal rank map and cannot be computed, and the benefit is also deity-gated and consumed at daily preparations. Needs a relative-rank slot lane.
Needs a lane that raises usesPerDay on innate spells ALREADY granted by other feats (and excludes the two highest ranks); innateSpells only adds new grants, it cannot amend existing ones.

The halcyon-speaker cantrip count and slot unlocks are hardcoded in casterArchetypes.ts customUnlocks; there is no data field to add one cantrip + one 1st-rank spell to another feat's archetype entry, nor to widen its tradition list to divine/occult.

byRank could write {1:1,2:1,3:1,4:1}, but the slots are usable ONLY for conscious-mind spells and the 5th-rank slot arrives at 18th — writing them plain would hand a 14th-level psychic four unrestricted slots. Needs slot restriction by spell source plus a level-gated slot grant.

Two slots restricted to a named spell list that both MOVES rank (2nd/3rd/4th at 6th/10th/14th) and grows its list. Needs slot restriction by spell id and a level-indexed rank ladder; byRank is static and unrestricted.

domains.ts holds only INITIAL domain spells, so choice{kind:'domains'} grants the wrong (and, after Domain Acumen, duplicate) spell. Needs an ADVANCED_DOMAIN_SPELLS table plus ADV_SPELL-style wiring; no field on the feat can name a domain-dependent spell.

CASTER_ARCHETYPES['bloodrager-dedication'] is cantrips-only with no ranked slots, so there is nothing for a slot bonus to increment and no entryId to name; needs the bloodrager archetype's ranked slot progression first.
Needs a 'add named spells to your spell list / spellbook / repertoire' lane; no field expands what a caster may prepare or learn from.

psychicSlots() stops at rank 9, and build.ts add() only increments a rank that already exists ('if (entry.slots?.[r])'), so byRank {10:1} would be silently inert. Needs a slot lane that can CREATE a rank the class table lacks (plus the two-spell rank-10 repertoire restriction).
Needs a daily-preparations borrowed-spell lane plus a cast-using-class-DC path; no field expresses either.

Needs an eidolon innate-spellcasting lane — the eidolon has no spellcasting entry, and putting the two cantrips in the feat's own innateSpells/effectChoices would grant them to the SUMMONER, which over-grants.
Depends on Infinite Mind's rank-10 slot, which the psychic table never creates (psychicSlots caps at 9) and add() cannot create; same missing lane as infinite-mind. byRank {10:1} would do nothing.

The cantrip is already covered by effectChoices; the remaining half needs a size-LOWERING lane — build.ts:3062 only applies sizeOverride when it is LARGER than the ancestry size, so 'medium' on a Large jotunborn is discarded.

Needs a repertoire-add lane: extra spells KNOWN in an ARCHETYPE spellcasting entry. halcyon-speaker-dedication is repertoire:true in casterArchetypes.ts, but grantedRepertoire (types.ts:1786) is only ever written by SUBCLASS options (grantedSpells, types.ts:813); no feat-level field feeds it. FEAT_CANTRIP_GRANTS is the wrong lane — it injects picks into the INNATE entry (at-will/1-per-day), which would mis-grant. The 'cast a halcyon spell as divine instead' clause is display-only.

Needs a PLAYER-CHOSEN-RANK slot lane. byRank names fixed ranks; this grants ONE slot at a rank the player picks each day (any rank up to two below the highest wizard rank), further restricted to curriculum spells. perRank+exceptHighest:2 would add a slot at EVERY eligible rank (massive over-grant), and byRank cannot encode 'one, rank of your choice'. Also needs a slot-contents restriction (curriculum-only), which no field expresses.

Needs a casterArchetypes.ts entry for 'gelid-shard-dedication' (archetype spellcasting progression: cantrips, slot ladder, trained spell attack/DC, repertoire:true). CASTER_ARCHETYPES is a hand-maintained code table, not a data field in types.ts — there is no field on the feat that can declare 'you gain the basic spellcasting benefits'. spellcastingGrant only sets an attack/DC profile, not slots. expert-snowcasting / master-snowcasting are dead for the same reason.

Needs a grants-an-inventory-item lane (no field creates an item in build.inventory) plus a staff charge pool fed by expending prepared spells at daily preparations, scaling to two spells at 8th and three at 16th. limitedUses is a fixed per-day counter and cannot model 'charges equal to the expended spell's rank'.

byRank exists but cannot CREATE a rank the entry does not already have: build.ts's add() is `if (entry.prepared?.[r]) entry.prepared[r].push(...)`, and animistPreparedSlots (spellcasting.ts:86) loops r=1..9 only, so the animist prepared entry has no rank-10 key and {"byRank":{"10":1}} is a silent no-op. Needs add() to materialise a missing rank (and the 'can't be used with abilities that give more slots' clause has no lane either).

Elf feats are already reachable via ancestryId; 'you can select elf, half-elf, and human feats' needs the ancestry-feat pool widened by heritage traits. featSlots.ts:56 consults only build.ancestryId and Heritage (types.ts:551) carries no extra-trait field. Missing lane: a heritage extraFeatTraits field consulted by eligibleFeatsForSlot.

Same as aon-half-elf: 'you can select orc, half-orc, and human feats' — the half-orc/human half of the pool is unreachable because featSlots.ts:56 filters ancestry slots on build.ancestryId alone and Heritage has no extra-feat-trait field. Missing lane: a heritage extraFeatTraits field consulted by eligibleFeatsForSlot.

Vision is modelled (senses + darkvisionIfAncestryLowLight). The unmodelled half is access to ardande AND geniekin feats at every ancestry-feat slot — featSlots.ts:56 filters on build.ancestryId only and Heritage (types.ts:551) has no field for extra allowed feat traits. Missing lane: a heritage extraFeatTraits field consulted by eligibleFeatsForSlot.

'You gain the Sneak Attack class feature' — derive.ts:1137 emits the precision rider only when ownedFeatureIds() has 'sneak-attack', and ownedFeatureIds (derive.ts:1089) is built solely from cls.features, subclass variants and classChoices; no feat can inject into it. A ModeDef grants check bonuses/defences/senses/speeds, not a precision-damage rider, so the new mode lane does not reach it either. Also needs a non-scaling 1d6 (derive.ts scales by character level). Missing lane: a feat-grants-a-class-feature lane feeding ownedFeatureIds, with a no-scaling flag.

Three branches, none expressible. Benefactor's Strike adds the deadly d6 trait to already-granted jaws/claws/tail unarmed Strikes — no lane adds a trait to an existing Strike. Dracomancer increments another feat's innate-spell uses per day by 1 — innateSpells declares uses outright, there is no increment-another-record's-uses lane. Kobold Breath's crit-fail persistent damage is entirely target-side. Modes grant defences/senses/speeds/check bonuses, none of which apply. Missing lanes: add-a-trait-to-a-granted-Strike, and increment-another-feat's-innate-spell-uses.

No new lane touches it. FeatGrant.conditionalSkills carries a single base→upgraded pair per skill, so the two printed branches (untrained→expert OR trained→master, player's pick, re-made every day) cannot both be written; bonusSkillFeat has no rank gate and no daily reset; and FeatChoiceDef.daily only records an answer.
missingLane: needs a daily-preparations skill-rank lane with two alternative base→upgraded branches plus a rank-gated bonus skill feat

why: Both branches attach damage to the nectar ranged unarmed Strike that Caustic Nectar grants, and core.feats['caustic-nectar'] has no grantedStrikes, so the Strike does not exist on the sheet. No lane (new or old) attaches a persistent/splash damage rider to another record's Strike; effectChoices' EffectGrant has no damage-rider field.
missingLane: needs a damage-rider lane on a granted Strike (persistent / splash), plus grantedStrikes on caustic-nectar

why: The primary grant widens your spell LIST with seven named spells so they can be prepared or added to a repertoire. grantedSpells (types.ts:814) exists only on SubclassOption and adds spells to the known list, not to the list you may prepare from; innateSpells would over-grant (free daily casts instead of list access). No feat field widens a tradition's spell list.
missingLane: needs a spell-list-widening lane on feats (add spells to the list you prepare/repertoire from)

why: strikePrecisionRiders (derive.ts:1137) fires only when ownedFeatureIds contains the rogue class feature 'sneak-attack', and hardcodes the dice as 1 + steps at L5/11/17. A flat, never-scaling 1d6 from a feat has no data field; none of the four new lanes (slots, mode defences/speeds, feat picks, weapon familiarity) touches strike damage.
missingLane: needs a precision-damage rider lane (fixed-die sneak attack granted by a feat, non-cumulative with the class feature)

why: Same wall as shadow-sneak-attack: the sneak-attack rider is computed from the rogue class feature id with level-scaled dice (derive.ts:1137), and there is no field for a feat-granted 1d4→1d6-at-6th precision die that never scales further.
missingLane: needs a precision-damage rider lane (fixed-die sneak attack granted by a feat)

why: Combat/Improved Flexibility is hardcoded in build.ts (two 'bonus' slots at levels 9 and 15) with featSlots.ts capping each at a fighter feat of level ≤ slotLevel-1. Nothing keys 'ultimate-flexibility'. There is no data field that adds a third flexibility slot or raises the existing slots' level ceilings.
missingLane: needs a combat-flexibility slot-count / level-ceiling override lane

why: mirrorBestCategory (lane 4) is the right mechanism but needs a STATIC weapons list, and here the weapon is whatever was chosen for Unconventional Weaponry — a choice value stored on a DIFFERENT feat. FeatGrant.choiceGrants is matched against the SAME feat's `fc.choice.value` (build.ts:2480), and unconventional-expertise carries no choice of its own; Unconventional Weaponry's own backfilled choice is still marked inert.
missingLane: needs a weaponFamiliarity whose weapon list is read from ANOTHER feat's choice value (cross-record choice reference)

why: AnimalCompanionType.maneuver (types.ts:1167) is a single string owned by the companion TYPE, and CompanionGrant has no maneuver field, so a feat cannot add an extra advanced maneuver to an existing companion. None of the four new lanes touches companions.
